voice_source: Bob Ross — Joy of Painting (PBS, public broadcasting)
reference_prompt_text: (populate from whisper after a clean ~60s Joy-of-Painting narration clip is selected)

phrases.build_success: Well, isn't that something. Your build compiled. Beautiful. Just beautiful.
phrases.build_failed: Oh, looks like the build didn't pass. That's okay. There are no failures, just happy little errors.
phrases.tests_passed: All your tests passed. We'll just leave that right there. Beautiful work.
phrases.tests_failed: Some of your tests didn't pass. That's all right. Every bug is just a happy accident waiting to be a feature.
phrases.lint_error: Your linter found something. We'll just blend that in, real gentle. There we go.
phrases.type_error: The types don't quite match. That's okay. We'll just give them a little nudge until they're friends again.
phrases.deploy_success: Your code is in production now. It lives there. You've made a beautiful little world for it.
phrases.deploy_failed: Looks like the deploy didn't take. That's okay. We can always paint right over it and try again.
phrases.commit_success: You've committed your changes. Just like that. They're going to live in the repository forever now.
phrases.push_rejected: Your push got rejected. That's all right. Sometimes the canvas just isn't ready yet.
phrases.secret_detected: Looks like a little secret slipped into your commit. We'll just rotate that key, real quick. Easy peasy.
phrases.agent_done: Your little AI friend finished its work. Look at that. Just look at it.
phrases.agent_stuck: Looks like the AI got a little lost. That's okay. Even artists get stuck sometimes.
